description: Election Commission - W. J. I. K. Fernando was elected as the member of the Kalpitiya P/S - A. K. A. Abdeen was elected as the member of the Kalpitiya P/S - S. M. A. Somasiri was elected as the member of the Angunakolapalessa P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Kalpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha and Angunakolapelessa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
